name: dreamchord
description: 梦弦 DreamChord - 节点式视觉小说创作平台

scripts.prepare:workspace: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server prisma generate
scripts.test:voice-runtime: node --test scripts/voice-runtime-config.test.mjs scripts/cosyvoice-runtime-config.test.mjs scripts/starter-voice-manifest.test.mjs scripts/starter-music-manifest.test.mjs scripts/official-soundtrack-manifest.test.mjs scripts/community-pack-manifest.test.mjs scripts/bilingual-cast-manifest.test.mjs scripts/dialogue-pack-manifest.test.mjs
scripts.demo:localize: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server exec tsx prisma/syncOfficialLocalization.ts
scripts.demo:cinema:seed: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server exec tsx prisma/seedSeventhRow.ts
scripts.demo:curtain:seed: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server exec tsx prisma/seedCurtainCall.ts
scripts.demo:paint:seed: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server exec tsx prisma/seedPaintPrologue.ts
scripts.demo:paint:upgrade: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server exec tsx prisma/upgradePaintPrologue.ts
scripts.demo:paint:chapter-one: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server exec tsx prisma/installPaintChapterOne.ts
scripts.demo:paint:chapter-three: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server exec tsx prisma/installPaintChapterThree.ts
scripts.demo:paint:release: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && pnpm --filter dreamchord-server exec tsx prisma/releasePaintBook.ts
scripts.test:paint: pnpm --filter @dreamchord/story-domain build && node --test scripts/paint-prologue-pack.test.mjs scripts/paint-music-sfx.test.mjs scripts/paint-chapter-one-pack.test.mjs scripts/paint-chapter-two-pack.test.mjs scripts/paint-chapter-three-pack.test.mjs scripts/paint-book-music.test.mjs
